full_name_ja: 第17回 小江戸大江戸200k
description_ja: スパルタスロンへの参加資格獲得大会として発足したウルトラマラソンで、川越の蓮馨寺をスタート・ゴールとします。小江戸(川越周辺)コースと、都庁・国立競技場・東京タワー・皇居・スカイツリー・浅草寺など東京の名所を巡る大江戸コースを走ります。90kmから260kmまでの種目があります。
description_en: This ultramarathon began as a qualifying race for the Spartathlon and starts and finishes at Renkeiji Temple in Kawagoe. Runners cover the Koedo course around Kawagoe and the Oedo course through Tokyo landmarks such as the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, the National Stadium, Tokyo Tower, the Imperial Palace, Skytree and Sensoji. Events range from 90 km to 260 km.
reception_note_en: Day-before reception: Fri, March 12, 16:00-19:00 at Renkeiji (except the Oedo Night 115km). Race-day reception on Sat, March 13: 6:00-7:30 for the 200k/230k/260k/90k, and 20:00-21:30 for the Oedo Night 115km.

categories.description_ja: 優先枠は小江戸大江戸200k大会の200km・230km・260kmの制限時間内完走者、一般枠は90km以上の大会の制限時間内完走者が対象。2023年以降開催の大会が対象。
categories.description_en: Priority entry is for finishers within the time limit of the 200km, 230km or 260km at this race. General entry is for finishers within the time limit of a race of 90km or more. Only races held in 2023 or later count.

categories.description_ja: 優先枠は小江戸大江戸200k大会の200km・230km・260kmの制限時間内完走者、一般枠は90km以上の大会の制限時間内完走者が対象。200kmを31時間でゴールできる実力が目安。
categories.description_en: Priority entry is for finishers within the time limit of the 200km, 230km or 260km at this race. General entry is for finishers within the time limit of a race of 90km or more. The organizer suggests being able to finish 200km in 31 hours.

categories.description_ja: 小江戸大江戸200k大会の200kmを27時間以内、または230km・260kmを制限時間内に完走した方が対象。
categories.description_en: Open to those who finished the 200km at this race within 27 hours, or the 230km or 260km within the time limit.

categories.description_ja: 42km以上の大会の制限時間内完走者が対象(一般枠のみ)。
categories.description_en: Open to those who finished a race of 42km or more within the time limit (general entry only).

categories.description_ja: 42km以上の大会の制限時間内完走者が対象(一般枠のみ)。夜22:00スタート。
categories.description_en: Open to those who finished a race of 42km or more within the time limit (general entry only). Starts at 22:00 at night.

nearby_spots.description_ja: ゴール後に参加賞の入浴券で3時間入浴できる。清掃のため朝7時〜9時は入浴不可。
nearby_spots.description_en: Runners can bathe for 3 hours after finishing with the bath ticket from the participation gifts. Closed for cleaning from 7:00 to 9:00.

participation_gifts.description_ja: オリジナルTシャツ、湯遊ランド入浴券、川越特産品など。発送は行わず、受付に来場した方のみへの手渡し。
participation_gifts.description_en: Original T-shirt, a Yuyu Land bath ticket, local Kawagoe specialty products and more. Items are not shipped and are handed out only at reception.
